'''House Ankerin''' is one of the known minor [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]].

The only known member of the House is Lady [[Carlys Ankerin]]. She supports [[Arymilla Marne]] for the [[Lion Throne]] during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]].
